_meta.trigger: User entered the duress PIN (covert panic). Fires AFTER the duress SMS has been dispatched to Trusted Contacts. The on-screen UI pretends to unlock normally — this notification is deliberately silent + hidden-from-lockscreen so the attacker doesn't see it.
_meta.scheduler: iOS: UNUserNotificationCenter immediate trigger with sound:nil + visibility:private. Android: NotificationManagerCompat.notify() with visibility=SECRET.
_meta.security_note: This notification must NEVER appear on the lock screen or notification center UI the attacker can see. iOS: use UNNotificationInterruptionLevel.passive + alert.title/body only shown post-authentication. Android: visibility=VISIBILITY_SECRET.

ios.visibility_hint: Shows only after user authenticates past App Lock. Do not surface on lock screen.

android.channel_description: Covert security confirmations that never surface on the lock screen.
android.title: Duress alert sent
